Camila —

Quick update: our CEO's flight into SFO was rescheduled by the airline this morning (mechanical issue) and the new ETA puts him in the office around 1pm on the 9th. He is insistent on attending the full workshop. We have two options on our end:
1) Push the entire session back by a day (not great for our leadership calendar).
2) Run the planned schedule on Nov 9 but change the CEO sessions to remote and have him join for the afternoon via Zoom.

Before I coordinate internally I wanted to check your recommendation — would Redwood be ok converting the CEO breakout to remote while keeping the rest of the day in-person? Also, we have a small contingent of external partners that would prefer in-person; I know that's not ideal.

Apologies for the late notice — airline changed the itinerary without much warning.

— Liam

Team — forwarding Liam's note. CEO ETA pushed to 1pm; they want to keep the day but remote the CEO portion. Need a quick ops feasibility check and a CS/eng decision on workshop format for the CEO breakout (we usually do hands-on live demo).

Primary asks:
- Sean: can we support a high-quality remote connection for the CEO's breakout (two-way handoff, shared whiteboard, breakout rooms)?
- Monica: will the CS/solutions team be comfortable running the breakout with one person dialing in? Any prep required?
- Aditya: if we convert to remote for that session, can engineering provide a short pre-recorded demo clip we can play in case of glitches?

I'll propose a fallback of moving the CEO session to an extended lunch slot 12:30—1:30pm if that helps. Also, let's be mindful of refunds / hotel modifications (they asked about comp nights).

Camila
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Crescent Peak — Exec Workshop (Nov 9) final agenda and travel

Camila / team —

We can absolutely support a hybrid flow for the CEO breakout. Plan:
- Primary room AV: HDMI + laptop, dual camera setup (room + close-up), dedicated mic pack for presenter.
- Backup: run Zoom from a secondary laptop on the conference network (separate NAT) to avoid local firewall/latency.
- I'll bring a Polycom mic and a hotspot if the venue Wi-Fi becomes flaky.
- Pre-recorded demo: yes, bring a 3–4 minute pre-record that we can cue.

Impact to schedule: none significant — just need a 20-min dry run with the CEO's P.A. on the morning of Nov 9.

I'll update the AV checklist and share the Zoom link after we lock the time.

—Sean

- Camila — please confirm whether we should leave the afternoon only for the CEO or keep the in-person breakouts overlapping. My preference: keep the main day and make the CEO session explicitly hybrid (call-out on the agenda).
